newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-GRAYSON SCORES ONE OF FASTEST HAT-TRICKS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GRAYSON SCORES ONE OF FASTEST HAT-TRICKS.

text.p: Neil Grayson, a 32-year-old striker with third division Northampton, scored one of the fastest hat-tricks in English soccer history when he scored three goals in four minutes against Hartlepool United in a league match on Saturday.
Grayson scored after 44, 45 and 48 minutes as Northampton won 3-0.
The fastest hat-trick in English league soccer was scored on November 1, 1952 when Jimmy Scarth scored three in two minutes for Gillingham against Leyton Orient.

Four players have scored three in three minutes. Saturday's haul by Grayson, who has also played for Doncaster, York and Chesterfield, is the fastest hat-trick since Gary Shaw scored three in three minutes for Shresbury against Bradford City in 1990.
